Our <strong>1-day beginner kitesurfing lesson</strong> is the perfect introduction or refresher.</p><ul><li><strong>Price</strong>: 325,000 KRW (all gear rental included)</li><li><strong>Fully customized</strong> to your skill level and personal goals</li></ul><p><strong>First time rider or just curious?</strong> This session will get you hooked!</p><h6><span style="letter-spacing: 0px; word-spacing: 0em;"><strong>Already riding but want to improve?</strong></span></h6><p><span style="letter-spacing: 0px; word-spacing: 0em;"> Take your skill to the next level with our <strong>advanced coaching sessions</strong>. 									<p>Your gear is your <strong>lifeline</strong> on the water. 					</h4>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1502" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1502"><p>During spring and fall you will have the highest chance for good windy days. The summer usually has lighter wind which is perfect for foiling. But don’t worry, Jeju island is known for its beauty, so even when there is no wind it will be worth to explore the island.</p></div>

For card transactions we have to charge an extra 10%.</p><p>In Seoul we only accept cash or bank transfers for now.</p></div>

There is public transportation but it can take a long time to reach some of the more secluded beaches.</p><p>If you’re staying at Seongsan, we can pick you up and drive together to the spots.</p></div>
